comparison_role: source-internal descriptive finite-fraction observation comparison; retrospective target-exposed nonscoring
fidelity_ceiling: Ten aggregate means and displayed SE; nominal equal windows; exact one-rate compression cost, not physical validation, practical adequacy or mechanism inference
source_rights: Matias et al. (2023), CC BY 4.0; derived replot

mapping.x: nominal cumulative endpoints 5 to 50 mL; each mark is a finite 5 mL vial
mapping.blue_line_and_circles: N minimax representative geometric sequence, not source continuum curve
mapping.gray_vertical_segments: reported SE endpoint readings; no confidence interpretation
mapping.orange_caps: G marginal recovery bands at true scale, often subpixel; horizontal cap width display only

source_overlay.role: source recovery verification only; original blue curve visible as source context, not an observation
source_overlay.mapping: source raster plus recovered rectangle, center and both segment directions; F02 covered endpoints and F10 clipping magnified
source_overlay.fidelity_ceiling: Authentication of stored geometry and occlusion; no experimental inference
